Ctrl-C is a byte until the kernel turns it into a signal

  

  

    

    
A program can catch the signal

    

    

      
1▶void handler(int sig) {

      
2▶  if (sig == SIGINT) printf("Received SIGINT!\n");

      
3▶  if (sig == SIGQUIT) { printf("Received SIGQUIT!\n"); exit(0); }

      
4▶}

      
5▶int main() {

      
6▶  signal(SIGINT, handler); signal(SIGQUIT, handler);

      
7▶  atexit(cleanup);

      
8▶  while (1) {

      
9▶    read(0, buf, sizeof buf);

      
10▶    printf("[%d] Got: %s\n", getpid(), buf);

      
11▶  }

      
12▶}
